subject.title: feat(sessions): grouping, unread state, and full session controls on web, iOS, and Android

question: After the Android blockers and merge conflicts are fixed, should this protected cross-client session-manager change land as one gateway/web/iOS/Android PR or be split into staged gateway and client follow-ups?
rationale: The PR adds new protocol parameters, persistent session read/activity state, and destructive controls across three clients, so final acceptance depends on maintainer product/API direction rather than only code correctness.

options.title: Fix And Continue This PR
options.body: Keep the current integrated PR as the landing vehicle after the Android blockers, conflicts, and upgrade proof are addressed.

options.title: Stage Gateway First
options.body: Split the gateway unread/fork contract into a smaller PR, then land web, iOS, and Android client controls separately.

options.title: Defer Direction
options.body: Pause the implementation and keep the linked feature issue open until maintainers settle the session-manager product contract.

recommendation.title: Fix And Continue This PR
recommendation.body: Keep the current integrated PR as the landing vehicle after the Android blockers, conflicts, and upgrade proof are addressed.

likelyOwner.reason: This person owns the linked feature proposal and has recent current-main work on the session-management surfaces affected here.
